name: LMArena
intro: LMArena 是 Chatbot Arena 改名后的持续运营平台。本条目以论文 v1 的匿名众包对战、逆采样概率加权 Bradley–Terry 排名和不确定性估计为核心，并按日期区分后续 Style Control、2025 年 CLT/频率重加权与清洗更新、以及 2026 年 Battles in Direct。论文表 1 的 243,329 是对话数，排名回放另使用 213,576 张历史选票；公开的 140K 数据只有 135,634 条文本记录，并非完整线上排名语料。
build_method: 论文 v1 匿名在线众包成对比较与主动采样；在线平台按日期扩展上下文 Bradley–Terry
metric: IPW 获胜矩阵, Bradley–Terry / Arena Score, 95% 置信区间, 近似排名
modality: 文本（论文核心；在线平台另有多模态扩展）
language: 149 种语言（论文快照；英文占 77%）
task_type: 开放式多轮对话, 人类偏好评测, 在线排行榜
eval_feature: 匿名盲测, 非均匀主动配对, 逆概率加权, 风格控制, 版本化质量过滤
variant: Renamed live continuation (paper v1 core plus dated online extensions)
modality_en: Text (paper core; the live platform later added multimodal arenas)
task_type_en: Open-ended multi-turn dialogue, human preference evaluation, live leaderboard
build_method_en: Paper-v1 anonymous crowdsourced pairwise comparison and active sampling, followed by dated contextual Bradley-Terry extensions on the live platform
eval_feature_en: Anonymous blind voting, non-uniform active pairing, inverse-probability weighting, style control, versioned quality filters
intro_en: LMArena is the renamed live continuation of Chatbot Arena. This entry keeps the paper-v1 anonymous crowdsourced battles, inverse-sampling-probability-weighted Bradley–Terry ranking, and uncertainty estimation as the core, while dating later Style Control, 2025 CLT/frequency-reweighting and cleaning updates, and 2026 Battles in Direct separately. The paper's Table 1 reports 243,329 conversations, whereas its ranking replay uses 213,576 historical votes; the public 140K release contains 135,634 text rows and is not the complete live ranking corpus.
language_en: 149 languages in the paper snapshot (77% English)
scale_en: Paper Table 1: 243,329 conversations / 50 models / 90,051 users; ranking replay: 213,576 votes; public 140K release: 135,634 rows
metric_en: IPW win matrix, Bradley–Terry / Arena Score, 95% confidence interval, approximate rank

drawio_review_note: Paper v1 is the upper-lane source of truth: terms and release consent, free-form multi-turn prompts, anonymous non-uniform model-pair sampling, four preference labels, post-vote reveal, identity-keyword exclusion, IPW win-matrix estimation, reweighted Bradley–Terry MLE, sandwich joint confidence sets, multiplicity-aware approximate ranks, and the CI-to-sampler feedback rule. Unsafe-content moderation (3% flagged), the 160-battle blind expert study, and the 25+25-IP anomaly experiment remain independent branches with no edge back into paper ranking. The lower lane dates post-paper changes: August 2024 Style Control becoming the text default in May 2025; July 2025 CLT intervals, frequency reweighting, and strengthened deduplication; September 2025 anomalous-user filtering; October 2025 self-battle removal; and May 2026 inclusion of Battles in Direct with two contextual features. Undisclosed live deduplication, anomaly-filter, and Direct-feature encodings are labeled as unavailable rather than inferred.

evidence.supports: Paper core collection, Table 1 snapshot, IPW win matrix, reweighted BT, sandwich confidence set, approximate rank, active sampling, expert validation, unsafe flag rate, and anomaly experiment
Current reference outcome encoding, BT/contextual-BT objectives, pair-frequency weights, style features, score scaling, and sandwich/bootstrap intervals
Legacy implementation evidence for randomized left/right placement and pre-ranking cleaning; it is post-paper and is not treated as the current canonical ranking implementation
Four style variables and contextual Bradley–Terry formulation
Dated CLT/frequency reweighting, deduplication, anomalous-user and self-battle filters, and Battles in Direct changes
Model eligibility, sampling policy, minimum-vote listing rule, partial-data release, and sensitive-data removal boundary
135,634-row text preference subset, four outcome labels, style metadata, and license boundary
Aggregated historical leaderboard snapshots and the official Elo-to-BT, Style-Control-default, and frequency-reweighting dates

paper_ranking_replay.note: Ranking and active-sampling experiment corpus; not the same count or unit as Table 1

public_preference_subset.scope: Text-only public subset; neither the paper snapshot nor the full live ranking corpus
public_preference_subset.license: User prompts are CC-BY-4.0; model outputs remain governed by provider terms

public_leaderboard_dataset.scope: Aggregated leaderboard snapshots, not raw battle rows

not_publicly_specified: Exact strengthened-deduplication key, threshold, and algorithm introduced in July 2025
Exact deployed anomalous-user filter and whether it reuses the paper's Fisher experiment
Exact encoding of is_direct_battle and same_org_indicator in the live fit
Whether the displayed live rank exactly reproduces the paper's multiplicity-corrected joint chi-square construction
